description: Pins for CI's torchsim_base image. pytorch_image is the ARG PYTORCH_IMAGE (FROM base) for Dockerfile.base; PyTorchSim is CPU-only (the npu PrivateUse1 backend simulates CUDA on the CPU), so the CPU PyTorch wheels are installed on top of a plain ubuntu base. The compiler and the simulators it runs (Spike, gem5) are pinned in pytorchsim-triton-backend.json instead. CI builds ghcr.io/.../torchsim_base:thirdparty-<12 hex> when missing (pin = sha256 of this file plus Dockerfile.base) and updates :latest on that push.
